The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.

Regarding the thematic structure of the provided text, the author’s motive is to use the wilting sunflower as a botanical metaphor to explore the consequences of neglect. This motive is structurally linked to the theme of human connection by drawing a parallel between the natural cycle of life and decay in plants and the deterioration of personal relationships caused by isolation. The narrative structure mirrors this thematic link by having the protagonist's internal emotional state (sadness, isolation) directly reflect the external physical state of the sunflower (wilting), thereby urging the reader to consider how neglect impacts both botanical and social bonds.
